answer.rationale: Prioritize a proven, durable self-serve growth lever: shortened/simplified onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, activation, and 30-day retention. Avoid promotional pricing as the primary response despite competitive pressure: the recovered discount experiment increased qualified revenue short term but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, creating material sustainable-value risk. Onboarding will not fully resolve price-driven churn conversations immediately, but it is the strongest available response aligned with long-term qualified revenue under the exhausted verification budget.
